calculation.description: For each instrument, compute negative three-session return divided by trailing 20-session return volatility, then remove the contemporaneous cross-sectional linear exposure to 20-session momentum. The signal uses only information available through the completed date.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC positive in 2020-2022 (+0.041966, 760 dates), 2023-2024 (+0.005258, 516 dates), and 2025-2027 (+0.037478, 574 dates). Five- and ten-day predictive power decays materially; use as a short-horizon sleeve. Small cross-asset universe warrants conservative interpretation.
validation.admission: Passes benchmark gates abs(IC)>=0.0070 and abs(ICIR)>=0.0840; deterministic library-correlation recomputation remains required.
